    left = [row[:4] for row in grid]
    right = [row[5:9] for row in grid]
    # Demo rule: retain left pattern when it contains at least as many colored cells;
    # otherwise superimpose the two patterns.
    nl = sum(v != 0 for row in left for v in row)
    nr = sum(v != 0 for row in right for v in row)
    if nl >= nr:
        return left
    return [[a if a else b for a, b in zip(lr, rr)] for lr, rr in zip(left, right)]
"
}
